question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: Constant practice is performed through yoga.
A specific age-form of sixteen years is mentioned.
The verb indicates this form may come to be.
inference: Therefore, through constant yogic practice one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
